source: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Table 8 importance factor I; IS 875 (Part 3):2015 Table 1 risk coefficient k1 by mean probable design life (the windImportance is the class's marker: the k1 of the category comes from wind.speedFactors.riskCoefficients at the town's Vb). The categories I-IV are SAEngine's slots for the code's classes.

I.description: Low hazard to life and property on failure (wind: 25-year class); seismic: all other buildings

II.description: All other buildings (seismic I = 1.0; wind: general buildings, 50-year class)

III.description: Business continuity structures; residential or commercial buildings with more than 200 persons (I = 1.2)

IV.description: Critical and lifeline structures: hospitals, schools, emergency buildings, power stations (I = 1.5; wind: important buildings, 100-year class)

sources.categories.II: IS 875 (Part 3):2015 Table 1 (50-year class, k1 = 1.0); IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Table 8 (iii)
sources.categories.III: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Table 8 (ii) and its note on buildings with more than 200 persons
